data.name: Crowned Sun
data.detailed_description:
Step into a fantasy world rooted in the myths and spirits of Yoruba, Candomblé, and the wider Afro-Brazilian tradition. Crowned Sun is a 3D isometric MMORPG that draws on the warmth and craft of classic online RPGs like Ragnarok Online, Tree of Savior, and Final Fantasy XIV — and gives them a setting almost no other game has dared to.

You arrive in Aruanda as one of four peoples — Human, Iwin, Egbere, or Ere — each with their own myth, identity, and feel in combat. Build your hero across two parallel tracks: a Base Level that grows as you adventure, and a Job Level that defines the path you walk. Train your skills in the plazas of Ifadun — the city many call the Mirage Kingdom — hunt through forests and ruins under a sun crowned in legend, and find your place in a community built around the orixás.

Crowned Sun is a love letter to the MMOs that shaped a generation — and a celebration of stories that fantasy rarely gets to tell.

Key Features

  • Afro-Brazilian fantasy world. Locations, races, and lore inspired by Yoruba mythology, the orixás, and Brazilian folklore — built with care, not exoticism.
  • Four playable peoples. Choose between Human (versatile, resilient), Iwin (forest-touched spirits), Egbere (shadow-bound damage dealers who trade defense for raw power), and Ere (childlike spirits with their own twist).
  • Classic dual-leveling. Earn Base Levels through adventure and Job Levels through your chosen class — the deep, layered progression that made Ragnarok Online and Tree of Savior unforgettable.
  • A living world of MMO systems. Parties, guilds, friends lists, pets, mercenaries, mounts, instanced Spirit Trials, large-scale Spirit War battles, mail, achievements, daily login rewards, and a Party Finder to bring it all together.
  • Orisha Echoes. A homage to the orixás and their forces, woven into the systems and progression of the world.
  • 3D isometric art with handcrafted heart. Cel-shaded characters, lush biomes, stone shrines wrapped in greenery, and a soundtrack drawn from the rhythms of the diaspora.
  • Cross-platform. Windows, macOS, and Linux/SteamOS support — bring the kingdom with you.

The World of Aruanda

A land of carved stone, sun temples, and woven prophecy. Towns hum with conversation; the wilderness hums with something older. Every quest is a thread, every region a story, and every orixá a memory you can find your way back to.

Who It's For

If you grew up on Ragnarok Online or Tree of Savior, if you spent late nights in classic Final Fantasy XIV cities, if you've ever wished a fantasy MMO would look beyond the same European myths — Crowned Sun is being made for you.

data.short_description: A 3D isometric MMORPG rooted in Yoruba, Candomblé, and Afro-Brazilian mythology. In the spirit of Ragnarok Online and Tree of Savior — choose from four peoples, master Base and Job levels, and find your place in Aruanda under a sun crowned in legend.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4150 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X (2 GB VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11 compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (6 GB VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11 compatible

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (8th gen or newer)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or Intel Iris Plus Graphics 655 / AMD Radeon Pro 555X
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro or newer
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Pro/Max GPU or newer
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4150 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X (Vulkan support, 2 GB VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA / PulseAudio compatible
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (Vulkan support, 6 GB VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA / PulseAudio compatible
